newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 17.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 17.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 56.57 points to 6,935.46 as news of mild inflation eased Wall Street's fears about rising interest rates.

* Indonesia's Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) was expected to increase required minimum total assets of a firm planning to list shares on the stock exchange to 100 billion rupiah from the current 20 billion rupiah, Neraca daily quoted Bapepam chairman I Putu Ary Suta as saying in Surabaya. He did not say when the move would come into force.
* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index closed down 3.15 points, or 0.47 percent, at 666.84 points.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,401.75/02.50 at 0140 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,400.75/01.50
* Barito Pacific on news its unit PT Tanjung Enim Lestari Pulp and Paper signed a $991 million loan agreement with 25 foreign banks on Friday for setting up a new pulp mill.
* Cigarette maker Sampoerna and noodle maker Indofood on news that Sampoerna's president director Putra Sampoerna plans to take a 15 percent stake in Indofood.
Also Indofood on announcing net profits rose to 351.31 billion rupiah in 1996 from 305.37 billion rupiah in 1995.
* Retailers Multipolar and Matahari on reports they were expected to merge.
* Chemical firm Aneka and sorbitol manufacturer Sorini on reports of sharp declines in 1996 net profits.
